Our vision is to enable our whole school community to live life in all its fullness. based on John 10:10
Prospective Parents
If your child is due to start school in September 2027, we are hosting prospective parent tours in the Autumn Term 2026.
We warmly invite prospective parents to take a tour of our school. Come and see how our vision of 'enabling our school community to live in all its fullness' is at the heart of all we do. Also, have a watch of our 'Welcome to St. Matthew's' story.
